svg.title: Book Tracker system context
svg.desc: Readers track personal books, use a shared author and work catalog, and may opt into reader comparisons. The operator curates shared authors, works, and editions. Book Tracker also reads external metadata, serves public profiles, and optionally synchronizes timers with Toggl Track.
